relation_completeness_lemma.statement: For this one-point genus-three model, every relation needed to add degree-at-most-three reduced representatives is witnessed by a nonzero function in L(9*infinity).
relation_completeness_lemma.argument: At the unique point at infinity, ord_infinity(u)=-2 and ord_infinity(v)=-7. Thus 1,u,u^2,u^3,u^4,v,u*v have distinct pole orders 0,2,4,6,8,7,9 and form the seven-dimensional Riemann-Roch space L(9*infinity). For reduced divisors D1,D2,D3 of degrees at most three, a relation D1+D2+iota(D3) has finite degree at most nine; any principal relation needed by the reduced-class law therefore has its function in this enumerated space. The oracle exhaustively enumerates its normalized projective functions and requires a unique resulting class sum.
relation_completeness_lemma.scope: This closes the relation-space completeness argument only for the recorded GF(8) fixture; it is not a general genus-three Jacobian theorem or catalog-wide oracle.

controls: Oracle field, polynomial, place, principal-divisor, source-group, target-group, pullback, and pushforward code must not import production arithmetic.
Enumerate 233 admissible graph places with degree counts 5, 44, and 184; reject the five inert degree-two places from principal zero supports.
Handle the ramified u=0 place with an independent local-series valuation and unramified places with independent Hensel valuations.
Require 486 unique canonical reduced divisor keys with degree distribution 1, 5, 56, and 424.
Require a unique sum for every unordered class pair and associativity for all 486^3 ordered triples.
Check all 486^2 ordered pushforward homomorphism pairs, all pullbacks, phi_*phi^*=[3], and e^2=[3]e.
Cross the production boundary only after the independent group table and maps have been constructed and checked.

Passed controls cover inert-place rejection, the ramified local valuation, infinity, the rational two-torsion fiber, shared support, repeated support, nonsplit support, conjugate support, and the complete non-table (a,b)=(0,1) production path.
Malformed-input, altered-field, altered-equation, altered-map, and missing-place mutation controls remain open and are not implied by the passing fixture replay.
